name: portrait-to-print
description: A private-by-default local photo-to-3D portrait workflow with bounded sculpting experiments and validated print exports.

interface.shortDescription: Local photo-to-portrait sculpting and print checks
interface.longDescription: Turn existing photographs into a locally generated and iteratively sculpted portrait, with private workspaces, an experiment ledger, repeatable Blender reviews, mesh validation, and printer-specific handoff. Requires a separately installed local generation backend; no model weights or portrait data are bundled.
defaultPrompt: Use my existing photos to make a locally sculpted printable portrait.
Refine this portrait mesh and record what improves or fails.
Prepare a reviewed portrait for my printer without sending a print job.
